body:
This project uses jackc/pgx v5.9.2 which lacks the `require_auth` configuration option (added in v5.10.0). Without it, pgx accepts ANY PostgreSQL auth method including no-password.

- **Advisory:** https://github.com/canolgun-commits/pgx/security/advisories/GHSA-xp64-pqg5-m7q8
- **Upstream fix:** pgx v5.10.0 (commit 1a976f7b)
- **Remediation:** go get -u github.com/jackc/pgx/v5@v5.10.0
- **Tool:** bounty-hunter vSurface variant propagation

**Note:** Not a zero-day. Fix exists upstream. Supply-chain notification.
title: Dependency: pgx v5.9.2 missing auth downgrade protection (CWE-306, fix in v5.10.0)
